Class KeyValueMap<K,V>

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.KeyValueMap<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - class of the keys in the map
V - class of the values in the map
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
public class KeyValueMap<K,V> extends SysMLAttributeType
SysMLinJava representation of an key-value map as a SysML value type. It emulates the jave Map interface and extends the SysMLValueType to provide a familiar mapping construct that can be used as a value in a block (an extension of the SysMLBlock class.

As an extension of the SysMLValueType, the KeyValueMap can be used for constraint parameters in parametric analysis. It can also by used as values and flows in blocks. SysMLinJava includes other value types for collections such as the ListOrdered and QueueFIFO.

ModelerOne

      protected void createUnits()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
